about.title: 关于我们
about.subtitle: 深国交最具专业度的赛车工程社团
about.description: Apex Racing起源于深国交的RC俱乐部，由一群对赛车工程充满热情的学生组建。
about.story: 面对去年NSL赛事因机械故障DNF的挫折，我们没有放弃。本学期，我们通过系统性的工程改进——从电子升级到精密调校——实现了车辆稳定性的突破，最终在全国赛场获得活塞组亚军及多项单项奖。

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: SCIE's Most Professional Racing Engineering Club
about.description: Apex Racing originated from SCIE's RC Club, founded by students passionate about racing engineering.
about.story: After a DNF at last year's NSL due to mechanical failure, we didn't give up. Through systematic engineering improvements—from electronics upgrades to precision tuning—we achieved a breakthrough in vehicle stability, ultimately winning 2nd place in the Pioneer class and multiple individual awards at the national competition.
